chunks: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) was asked about the saying of God, Mighty and Majestic: "Did We not give you lives long enough so that whoever wanted to be mindful could have done so?" [35:37] So he said: A rebuke to one who has reached eighteen years of age.

key_terms.تَوْبِيخ: Rebuke — a divine reproach for failing to take heed
key_terms.نُعَمِّرْكُم: We gave you a long life — Quranic phrase about the sufficiency of lifespan for reflection

ai.seo_question: At what age does accountability begin according to Imam al-Sadiq's interpretation of Quran 35:37?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interprets the Quranic verse 35:37, which questions whether people were given enough time to reflect, as a divine rebuke directed at those who have reached eighteen years of age. This interpretation establishes eighteen as the age from which a person is expected to begin mindful reflection on divine guidance, lower than the forty-year threshold mentioned in other traditions.
